title: Networking Basics
description: Four short beginner modules on how devices connect, how the internet moves data, and how to stay safe and fix simple problems. Everything works offline.

modules.title: Introduction to Computer Networks
modules.summary: What is a network? Devices that share information, LAN, WAN and the internet.

modules.title: Networking Devices and Connections
modules.summary: How do devices connect? Routers, switches, modems, access points, Ethernet and Wi-Fi.

modules.title: IP Addresses and Internet Communication
modules.summary: How does information reach the right device? IP addresses, DNS, packets and website requests.

modules.title: Network Safety and Basic Troubleshooting
modules.summary: How can users stay connected and safe? Wi-Fi protection and step-by-step troubleshooting.
